parameters.content: from unittest import TestCase from mistune import create_markdown class TestAutoseIssue2FR001(TestCase): def test_ac_fr_003_1(self): """AC-FR-003-1: Given Markdown input 'visit https://example.com.', when markdown is created with plugins=['url'], then output HTML contains 'https://example.com.'.""" md = create_markdown(plugins=["url"]) result = md("visit https://example.com.") self.assertIn('https://example.com.', result) def test_ac_fr_003_2(self): """AC-FR-003-2: Given Markdown input 'see https://example.com, and more', when markdown is created with plugins=['url'], then output HTML contains 'https://example.com, and more'.""" md = create_markdown(plugins=["url"]) result = md("see https://example.com, and more") self.assertIn('https://example.com, and more', result) def test_ac_fr_001_1(self): """AC-FR-001-1: Given Markdown input 'see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Python_(programming_language) for details', when markdown is created with plugins=['url'], then output HTML contains link with parentheses.""" md = create_markdown(plugins=["url"]) result = md("see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Python_(programming_language) for details") self.assertIn( 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Python_(programming_language)', result ) def test_ac_fr_004_1(self): """AC-FR-004-1: Given Markdown input '[link https://example.com]', when markdown is created with plugins=['url'], then output HTML handles brackets according to existing mistune url plugin rules.""" md = create_markdown(plugins=["url"]) result = md("[link https://example.com]") self.assertIn('href="https://example.com"', result)
